intro: One playthrough is enough, and every trophy is offline. Play the story first, do the one missable thing early, then clean up by theme. About 200 hours (PowerPyx) to 300 hours or more (Push Square). Cheats disable trophies and saving, so leave them off for the whole run.

stages.summary: Finish the campaign in order. This stage earns the 12 chapter and mission trophies, the gold for the final mission, and the three vague story trophies.
stages.tip: Do this first, before anything else: in Chapter 1, meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house. It is the one possibly missable trophy in the game (Positive Mental Attitude) — the spot is reported to disappear after Chapter 1.
stages.title: Play the story — Chapters 1 to the finale

stages.summary: Finish the five side-character chains and eight qualifying stranger strands. These unlock as you explore, so take their markers whenever they appear.
stages.tip: For Strangers & Freaks, only some strands count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do; the chains for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy have their own trophies and do not count here.
stages.title: Side characters and strangers

stages.summary: Shooting ranges, drone races, races, stunts, fishing, the arcade and bowling. The two silver trophies here — 250 stunts and 42 shooting-range golds — are the longest grinds.
stages.tip: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges, and win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Track everything from Touch Pad, Activities.
stages.title: Activities and races

stages.summary: Cards, WAiNK scans, vehicles and the whole map. Slow, steady work — do a little of each while travelling between other jobs.
stages.tip: Three card sets are enough for the trophy, but 15 of the 18 sets are needed for 100% completion.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploring

stages.summary: Vaults, armored trucks, gang operations, jewelry stores, marked bills, spending and property. Most of these feed each other — robberies raise the wanted level the partner trophies need.
stages.tip: Bank vaults open with an optional Chapter 4 mission and always bring 4 stars — park a fast bike nearby. Launder Marked Bills through your contacts after every big job; the $250,000 is a running total.
stages.title: Crime and money

stages.summary: Finish the Challenges list, open the 100% Completion checklist after the story, and work it down line by line. The platinum pops with the last trophy.
stages.tip: 100% needs 70 of the 80 Challenges, 300 of the 397 stunts, 15 of the 18 card sets and all 42 drone races — more than the individual trophies ask, so expect to return to those activities here.
stages.title: Clean-up and 100% completion

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
